name: Magpie 模型网关
description: 可选下载的 magpie 本机模型网关（yetone/magpie 原版程序，MIT）。统一管理 API 密钥、订阅登录账号与路由组，查看额度与用量，并在会话中使用它的模型。取代订阅中心与 WorkBuddy 号池。

features.name: magpie 原版网关：按需启动、私有数据目录、禁用即停
features.nameEn: Original magpie gateway: on-demand start, private data folder, stops when disabled

features.name: API 密钥供应商与密钥池（在 magpie 控制台中管理）
features.nameEn: API-key providers and key pools (managed in the magpie console)

features.name: 订阅账号登录、本机登录发现与额度窗口（在 magpie 控制台中）
features.nameEn: Subscription sign-ins, local sign-in discovery and quota windows (in the magpie console)

features.name: 路由组：顺序、轮换与额度感知切换（在 magpie 控制台中）
features.nameEn: Routing groups: order, rotation and quota-aware failover (in the magpie console)

features.name: magpie 模型与路由组进入会话模型选择和模型设置
features.nameEn: magpie models and routing groups in conversation model selection and Model settings

features.name: 用量与费用统计（在 magpie 控制台中）
features.nameEn: Usage and cost statistics (in the magpie console)

features.name: magpie 原版控制台内嵌在 Xueness 面板中，不另做一套管理界面
features.nameEn: magpie's own console embedded in the Xueness panel instead of a separate management UI
